The statute most likely began when the widow died in 1986, because her will vested the cottage in the Boy Scouts at that moment. The other option is wrong: a lessor's death does not terminate a lease, so the tenant did not become a trespasser in 2009. Confidence is limited because the lease ran until 1992, and some jurisdictions start the clock on a reversion only when it becomes possessory, which could move the start date to 1992.

CONFIDENCE: 50
